system.effect: Occult smartphone: Level 1 banishing, binding, entropy manipulation, exorcism, glamour, scrying, and wards at a touch.
system.description: A jailbroken early iPhone loaded with a full suite of occult apps. Simple Level 1 effects activate with a DN 4:1 Mind (Technology) Test and no Magic roll; complex spells still require a normal casting roll. Requisition DN 4:2; Certification Introduction to Applied Occult Computing.
